source: Build an obby where players climb a tower of floating blocks and platforms to reach a flag at the top.

image_prompt.text: A chain of floating blocks and platforms stacking and wrapping upward, spaced to the physics limits, with no surrounding terrain beneath them
Platforms that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation, on the way up
Trusses, ladders, and wall scrambles linking the floating sections
A flag at the summit marking the top of the climb

layout_placement.text: The goal at the top of the tower, triggered by reaching the flag

notes: The flag was promoted to the end reward area, which is the closest loaded option, but that option is written as a payoff - tools, morphs, speed - and the user asked for a goal marker. Nothing is being rewarded here except finishing.
The Tower Obby preset carries no checkpoints, which matches the tower-of-hell style it is modelled on. A long climb with no checkpoint is a real difficulty decision the user did not make.
A tall tower may not fit a single top-down frame. If the climb is more than a few hundred studs, decompose it into stacked segments rather than accepting one image.

open_questions.ask: What should the tower look like - candy-coloured blocks, grimy industrial, floating fantasy islands?
How tall is the tower? That decides whether it can be framed in one pass.
Should there be checkpoints on the way up, or does falling send you back to the bottom?

coverage_missing.ask: What does the tower look like?

answers.ask: What should the tower look like - candy-coloured blocks, grimy industrial, floating fantasy islands?
answers.answer: Use a simple colourful cartoon obby look: bright floating blocks and platforms against a clear sky.

answers.ask: How tall is the tower? That decides whether it can be framed in one pass.
answers.answer: Make it a small tower, roughly 12–15 platform jumps tall, so the full climb can be framed in one pass.

answers.ask: Should there be checkpoints on the way up, or does falling send you back to the bottom?
answers.answer: Include a few checkpoints along the way up so falling does not always send players back to the bottom.
